keyring.label: Databases
quickHint: Connects once; it is kept under Recent, not in the favorites
unavailable: The database helper (lord-sql) isn't installed on this system, so Databases can't connect yet. Favorites and the import still work.
later: Coming in a later version of Databases.
f.name: Name
iamLater: Signing in with an IAM token (made from an access profile, valid for 15 minutes) comes in a later version; use a password for now.
ssh.later: SSH tunnels come in a later version: this favorite is kept, but it can't connect yet.
tls.identity: Check that the endpoint matches the certificate
pw.kept: The password is kept in Passwords.
pw.notKept: Passwords couldn't keep it (is Passwords locked?).
pw.typeFirst: Type the password first, then keep it in Passwords.
pw.title: Password for {name}
pw.detail: The server asks for the password of {user} on {server}. Leave it empty to connect without one.
pw.imported: This connection was imported: its password stayed with the other app. Type it once, and keep it in Passwords if you want.
cert.title: The server's certificate didn't check
cert.detail: {name} answered with a certificate this computer can't verify. Trust it only if you know this is the right server: from then on, only this exact certificate is accepted for it.
cert.subject: Issued to
cert.hint: Compare the fingerprint with the one your database administrator gives you.
fav.none: No favorites yet: fill in the form and choose Save Changes, or import them.
fav.deleteDetail: The favorite and its kept password are removed. The database itself isn't touched.
fav.err.name: Give it a name.
fav.err.idTaken: Another favorite has the same id.
fav.err.type: Choose Standard, Socket, SSH or Cloud.
fav.err.socket: The socket must be a full path, like /run/mysqld/mysqld.sock.
fav.err.host: The host isn't a valid name or address.
fav.err.port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
fav.err.user: The user name is too long or has a line break.
fav.err.database: The database name is too long.
fav.err.certPair: A client certificate needs both its certificate and its key.
group.name: Group name
import.title: Import connections

import.foundHome.one: Found {count} connection from {app} in your home folder.
import.foundHome.other: Found {count} connections from {app} in your home folder.

import.none: No Sequel Ace or Sequel Pro favorites were found in your home folder or on the disks you connected. Connect the other computer's disk and try again.
import.err.binary: saved in a format that can't be read here
import.passwords: Passwords aren't imported: they stay where the other app kept them. Each one is asked the first time you connect, and you can keep it in Passwords.

import.done.one: Imported {count} connection. Its password wasn't brought over: it's asked the first time you connect, and you can keep it in Passwords.
import.done.other: Imported {count} connections. Their passwords weren't brought over: each is asked the first time you connect, and you can keep it in Passwords.

pickDb: Choose a database in the toolbar.
pickTable: Choose a table or a view.
addTableLater: New tables come in a later version
closed.crash: The connection's helper stopped unexpectedly; only this tab was affected.
lock.title: Unlock {name} for changes?
lock.detail: This favorite is marked as production. Once unlocked, edits, ALTER and the queries you run can change its data until you close the connection.
lock.footer: Read only: unlock the connection in the toolbar to change it.
st.viewReadOnly: A view's structure is read only
st.dropDetail: Its data goes with it when you apply the change.
st.applyDetail: This statement runs on the server and changes the table for everyone who uses it:
st.onUpdate: Set to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP when the row changes
st.notYet: Nothing changes on the server until you choose Apply below the fields.
field.err.name: The name must have 1 to 64 characters, without spaces at the ends.
field.err.lengthNeeded: This type needs a length (or the values, for ENUM and SET).
field.err.enumValues: Write the values in quotes, separated by commas: 'a','b'.
field.err.length: The length isn't valid for this type.
field.err.nullDefault: A field that doesn't allow NULL can't default to NULL.
field.err.noDefault: This type can't have a default value.
field.err.autoIncrement: Only number fields can auto increment.
field.err.collation: The collation isn't a valid name.
field.err.columns: Choose the columns of the index.
content.deleteDetail: They're removed from {table} on the server. This can't be undone.
content.noChange: The server changed no row: someone may have changed or removed it meanwhile.
content.addHint: A field left empty takes its default value. For a binary column, write 0x and the hexadecimal bytes.
q.noHistory: Nothing run yet with this favorite
q.safeOn: Safe mode: asks before UPDATE or DELETE without WHERE
q.safeToggle: Turn safe mode on or off

q.safeDetail.one: {count} statement has no WHERE, so it changes or deletes every row of its table:
q.safeDetail.other: {count} statements have no WHERE, so they change or delete every row of their tables. The first:

q.hint: Write a query and press Ctrl+Enter to run the statement under the cursor, or Ctrl+Shift+Enter to run them all.
console.title: Console — {name}
console.gone: This connection is closed, and its log went with it.
console.notSaved: The log couldn't be saved there.

console.footer.one: {count} entry since connecting at {time} · the log stays in memory and is cleared when you disconnect
console.footer.other: {count} entries since connecting at {time} · the log stays in memory and is cleared when you disconnect

err.unavailable: The database helper (lord-sql) isn't installed or can't start.
err.notfound: That favorite isn't saved anymore. Save it again and connect.
err.dns: The server's name couldn't be found. {message}
err.connect: The server didn't accept the connection: check the host, the port and the network. {message}
err.tls: The encrypted connection couldn't be set up. {message}
err.cert: The server's certificate couldn't be verified.
err.auth: The server refused the user name or password.
err.busy: A query is still running on this connection; wait for it to finish.
err.toolarge: The answer is too large (over 64 MB). Ask for fewer rows or columns.
err.unsupported: This kind of connection isn't supported yet.
err.readonly: This connection is read only. Unlock it in the toolbar to make changes.
err.nokey: This table has no primary key or unique key without NULLs, so a row can't be told apart from the others. Edit it with an UPDATE in Query.
err.view: A view's rows can't be edited here.
err.badhex: A binary value must be 0x followed by pairs of hexadecimal digits.
err.fullAuthTls: This server needs the password sent once over an encrypted connection whose certificate was checked, so nobody in between can read it. Set TLS to Verify for this favorite (or trust the server’s certificate when asked) and connect again.
